procedures.source:
&First = new()
Msg("default_label=[" + &First.Label + "]", status)
Msg("default_fixed=[" + &First.Fixed + "]", status)
&First.Label = "alpha "
&First.Fixed = "beta "
&Second = &First
&Second.Label = "alias "
Msg("alias_first=[" + &First.Label + "]", status)
Msg("alias_second=[" + &Second.Label + "]", status)
&Second = &First.Clone()
&Second.Label = "clone "
&Second.Fixed = "other "
Msg("clone_first=[" + &First.Label + "]", status)
Msg("clone_second=[" + &Second.Label + "]", status)
Msg("fixed_first=[" + &First.Fixed + "]", status)
Msg("fixed_second=[" + &Second.Fixed + "]", status)
Print(&First.Label.Length())
